name: Totsuzen Kaijin ni Sareta Ore to Akuochi Suru Mahou Shoujo no Hanashi
original_name: 突然怪人にされた俺と悪堕ちする魔法少女の話
source:
There is an organization, Death Brand, plotting to conquer the world.

And there is an organization of justice, Justia, which is trying to obstruct the plan.

These two organizations signed a "War Pact" promising to wage war while adhering to the rule — "Do not involve ordinary people in fight" — and they did so, fighting day after day.

However, one day during the war, unrelated students Tsujitani Takashi and Minakura Kumi were abducted by one of Death Brand's divisions—Death Heat.To break Death Heat's present inferiority, they put into use a despicable strategy ignoring the War Pact: they subjected ordinary citizens to a remodeling surgery and turned them into military assets.

Luckily for these two, they were saved by Justia's magical girl, Iren, yet it was too late and they were already remodeled: Takashi into a monster and Kumi into a magical girl. They asked for help to turn them back to humen, but were told that in order to do so, there was no method but to complain to Death Brand, get them to admit that they were at fault, and undergo restoration surgery. Furthermore, Iren was their classmate, Akazuki Ayane, and she too was taken away and remodeled, as she explained.

Death Brand performs an internal inspection and needs about two weeks to capture the fact of Death Heat's violation of the Pact. Death Heat, on the other hand, desperately tries to intervene, even attempting to have the two undergo brainwashing surgery.

"We will never... ever forgive them!"

In order to defend themselves and for the tragedy not to repeat itself, two of them decide to fight. Will they actually be able to return to human form?

translation:
有一个名为“死亡烙印”的组织，正密谋征服世界。

另有一个名为“Justia”的正义组织，竭力阻止其阴谋。

两个组织签订了“战争协定”，约定交战时必须遵守“不将普通人卷入战斗”的规则。此后，双方就这样日复一日地争斗着。

然而，在某日的战斗中，与战争毫无关系的学生辻谷孝志和南仓久美却被死亡烙印旗下的“死亡烈焰”部门绑架。为了扭转当前的劣势，死亡烈焰使出了无视战争协定的卑劣手段：他们对普通市民实施改造手术，将其变成作战兵器。

所幸，两人被Justia的魔法少女艾琳救了出来。可惜为时已晚，他们已经完成改造：孝志成了怪人，久美则成了魔法少女。二人请求帮助，希望恢复人类之身，得到的答复却是：唯一的办法，就是找死亡烙印讨说法，迫使对方承认过错，再接受复原手术。艾琳还向他们坦白，自己其实正是两人的同班同学秋月绫音，也曾被抓走并接受改造。

死亡烙印随即展开内部调查，大约需要两周才能查清死亡烈焰违反协定的事实。另一边，死亡烈焰则不惜一切妨碍调查，甚至试图再次抓住二人，为他们实施洗脑手术。

“我们绝不……绝不饶恕那些家伙！”

为了保护自己，也为了不让悲剧重演，二人决意战斗。他们究竟能否恢复人类之身？
